digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu.status: Policy read; CC BY 4.0 with exceptions
digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu.note: EU-owned content generally CC BY 4.0; source title, EU credit, URL and changes must be identified. Rights in private individuals, third-party works and branding are separate. The Grok record includes attribution, licence link and a change notice; no source media used.

judiciary.uk.status: Policy read; Open Government Licence with exceptions
judiciary.uk.note: Crown copyright and OGL apply unless otherwise indicated, excluding Royal Arms and logos. Source title and Crown copyright acknowledgement required. Getty judgment is linked and condensed with an editorial lesson; no exhibits or artwork republished.

justice.gov.note: Most staff-created material is public domain unless indicated otherwise. Third-party material and insignia have separate restrictions; no blanket worldwide clearance inferred.

ftc.gov.status: Policy copyright section retrieved through search index; direct retrieval failed
ftc.gov.note: The full indexed copyright section was read on 15 October, improving the earlier excerpt-only review. Most government-created FTC material is public domain; third-party works, seals and implied endorsement are excluded. Attribution is retained.

ntsb.gov.note: Staff-created reports are generally public domain; embedded third-party works are not automatically reusable. Accuracy and completeness requested. No source photos or seal used.

priv.gc.ca.note: Reproduction conditions require accuracy, title and author identification and identification of the website version. Commercial redistribution needs written permission; third-party material and symbols have exceptions. Current use is factual commentary with source links, not a reproduced document.

oaic.gov.au.status: Policy read; CC BY 4.0 with exceptions
oaic.gov.au.note: Website content generally CC BY 4.0; third-party content, logo, coat of arms, trademarks, images and photographs excluded. Required source attribution is added to the case source note; no excluded assets used.

content.govdelivery.com.status: Publisher-specific policy not verified after search; official bulletin read
content.govdelivery.com.note: This is an EEOC-authored bulletin hosted by GovDelivery. Hosting-provider terms are not treated as an EEOC content licence. General US government-work guidance is not an item-specific clearance. No bulletin body or assets republished.

nhd.uscourts.gov.status: Publisher-specific policy not verified after homepage and search review
nhd.uscourts.gov.note: The cited item is a judicial sanctions order. No court-specific reuse policy was established; no court website or PDF is republished. Justia separately disclaims copyright in government court documents. This does not clear any third-party attachments.

docs.justia.com.note: Section 18 disclaims Justia copyright in US government works, including court documents. This does not license Justia annotations, software, design or other third-party material. Only facts of the linked order are discussed.

info.gov.hk.status: ISD publisher policy read; conditional educational reuse
info.gov.hk.note: ISD maintains the government press-release service. Its notice permits non-commercial personal or educational use of government information with accurate reproduction and copyright acknowledgement; media and third-party works have exceptions. Case source note acknowledges HKSAR Government copyright; no source media copied.

fcc.gov.status: General website policy read; content reuse permission unresolved
fcc.gov.note: Accessible policy covers linking, privacy and site operation; it did not establish a content-specific reuse grant for this PDF. Current website-notices retrieval failed. No PDF, seal or source media republished; factual summary and citation only.

nhpr.org.note: Links encouraged without endorsement; republication and media reuse restricted. A brief factual outcome and link are used, not the report, audio or photograph. No special permission or fair-use determination claimed.

blogs.microsoft.com.status: General copyrighted-content policy read; no blog-specific reuse grant assigned
blogs.microsoft.com.note: Microsoft retains rights in its content and describes limited permissions and exceptions. The policy is not treated as a general licence for republishing the Tay blog. Only factual discussion and a link are used; no blog body, screenshot or logo copied.

aclumich.org.note: Some non-commercial text distribution is permitted without editorial changes or misleading presentation and with a copyright notice, unless a page says otherwise. The project presents its own factual account and clearly labels interpretation; it does not claim that the distribution permission licenses a rewritten article.

gov.uk.status: Policy read; Open Government Licence with exceptions
gov.uk.note: Most GOV.UK content is under the OGL; other rights are identified separately. Crown copyright and OGL attribution are recorded in the source note. No government branding used or endorsement implied.

royalcommission.gov.au.status: Policy read; CC BY 4.0 with exceptions
royalcommission.gov.au.note: General website licence excludes the coat of arms, Royal Commission logo and third-party content. Commonwealth attribution and a licence link are added to the case source note. Report and exhibits are not redistributed.

fedcourt.gov.au.status: Policy read; speech is not treated as a judgment licence
fedcourt.gov.au.note: Policy distinguishes judgments from other material. The cited Kyrou item is a speech; limited unaltered personal or organisational use is not assumed to grant public adaptation rights. Only a brief factual account and source link are retained; speech text is not republished.

dfs.ny.gov.status: Publisher-specific reuse policy not verified after search; privacy policy read
dfs.ny.gov.note: The privacy policy is not a copyright licence. Homepage and cited press release were read; no applicable reproduction grant was established. New York state material is not automatically covered by the US federal government-work rule. Factual commentary and link only.

amnesty.org.note: General materials licence includes attribution, non-commercial and no-derivatives conditions, with exceptions. No reliance on that licence to republish, adapt or translate its expression. Brief factual discussion and link only; no report or images reproduced.

wsj.com.status: Policy inaccessible; primary policy retrieval failed
wsj.com.note: WSJ and Dow Jones policy URLs were attempted; no authoritative full policy was retrieved. Third-party policy mirrors were not used to assert permission. The brief historical account remains explicitly attributed to reporting, not established as a court finding. No article body or assets reproduced. Permission and contractual application unresolved.

sec.gov.note: SEC FAQ permits reuse of government-created content and public EDGAR filings, noting exceptions such as stock photographs. Project cites SEC press releases; no stock art, seal or filing attachments copied.

garanteprivacy.it.status: Publisher-specific policy not verified after homepage, article and search review
garanteprivacy.it.note: The relevant public releases were accessible, but an applicable content-reuse licence was not established. No automatic public-domain assumption for Italian regulator material. Brief factual reporting and links only; no translated article or source assets distributed.

pipc.go.kr.status: Article and English/Korean website notices read; item licence unresolved
pipc.go.kr.note: English article and Korean website footer reserve rights. No applicable item-level open licence was established; government status alone is not treated as permission. Only a brief factual account and citation, no release body, attachment or image, are used.

nhtsa.gov.note: Ownership section permits distribution and copying of public information; no warranty of third-party non-infringement or endorsement is given. Current project uses a factual account and citation, no branding or media.

theverge.com.note: Publisher reserves rights and restricts republication. Original-report facts are discussed briefly, not article text or photographs. No publisher permission or legal clearance inferred.

wired.com.status: Policy inaccessible (403 previously; retrieval failed again); article read
wired.com.note: Article was rechecked for sale price, earlier credit and apology. No reuse licence assumed from article access. No article body, source photos or interviews quoted verbatim; policy and contractual application remain unresolved.

christies.com.note: Terms explicitly restrict public use and summaries. The auction-house source was removed from the published case and its audit locators. Retained facts are supported by WIRED and The Verge; the exact sale-day detail was dropped. No artwork or auction media used.

oecd.ai.status: Linked terms read; date and content-type distinctions recorded
oecd.ai.note: OECD.AI links to these terms. Written content before/after July 2024 and legal instruments have separate conditions; adaptations require a disclaimer and third-party rights remain separate. Guide uses independent learning prompts informed by principles, not reproduced or translated OECD text; no item-specific CC licence assigned.

nist.gov.note: NIST distinguishes employee-authored works, Standard Reference Data, third-party works and foreign rights. Guide cites the AI RMF and writes independent task-specific prompts; it does not redistribute the framework, data or software. No NIST endorsement claimed.

unesco.org.status: Official publication catalogue licence read; full English licence notice not retrieved
unesco.org.note: UNESCO-UNEVOC lists the 2023 guidance as CC BY-SA. Full English repository notice did not render, so version and asset exceptions are not inferred from that catalogue label. No report text, translation or images redistributed; guide offers independent educational prompts and a source link.

copyright.gov.status: Legal policy read; linking conditions recorded
copyright.gov.note: Links must not imply affiliation or endorsement; third-party intellectual property must be respected. The guide links to the permissions FAQ and gives independent educational prompts, not copies of the website or a determination that a user's work is lawful.

eeoc.gov.status: Statutory government-work basis read; limited agency-authored source selection
eeoc.gov.note: The original EEOC enforcement release identifies the agency as its author. Selected on the government-work distinction in 17 USC §§101 and 105; this is an editorial assessment, not a publisher-specific grant or a worldwide legal clearance. No imported testimony, third-party assets, logo or article body is reproduced.
